section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item measure rated on a 5-point Likert scale, with item scores averaged to produce an overall body appreciation score. It notes prior validation work and reports that in the present study the BAS had good internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha = .89). The section refers to "the present study" but does not label it as Study 1 or provide sample, demographic, or BMI/correlation data.
